reviewer_notes: This is a policy/database paper on the EU-MERCI project. It does not build a fitted statistical energy performance model; the only 'energy performance model' construct is the set of nine Key Performance Indicators (Primary Energy Savings, Energy Consumption Improvement, Energy Intensity Reduction, etc.) computed over a database of ~2,906 EE project records across four countries. M1 represents that KPI/indicator framework; most model-specific fields are not applicable or not reported because no equations, coefficients or validation are published in this article (they are referenced to separate project papers). The refinery/petrochemical flag is set because the coke and refined petroleum products (NACE C19) sector is present in the database and its savings/costs are reported empirically.
